pipeline: Camera token identifies render reference and simulation timestamp; no GPU wall-clock exposure timestamp is available.
SharedFramePool assigns the first owning-context monotonic acquired_at before copying/semantic preparation and preserves it for reused buffers.
Owner assembles exposure-matched immutable robot poses and submits to one-running/one-replaceable-pending mapping I/O worker.
Background I/O thread serializes calibrated frames and immutable robot mesh instances to the existing SDK-free subprocess.
Worker validates original timestamps/tokens, allocates1024rays, masks selected robot rays, traverses rays, integrates temporal occupancy, snapshots and extracts exact occupied cuboids.
Full immutable snapshot plus obstacle packet returns through IPC; owner observation callback checks age/generation before atomic publication.
Reactive checks the actual published original acquisition age before each action and after each Kit yield; only accepted packet sync updates last_applied diagnostics.
interpretation: All four2Hz and all four2.5Hz attempts failed for unavailable/stale mapping during empty-workspace setup, before requested external actors were placed for a measured route.
The rate change alone did not cure availability. These eight attempts do not establish a reliable or causal rate advantage; they are not route-avoidance comparisons.
The dominant worker span is exact robot self-filter intersection work. Packet BVH was selected for an exact optimization after all baseline evidence had been obtained.
Source freshness remains1s. No timestamp is rewritten, failure bypassed or direct fallback used.
qualifications: All stage values are seconds unless a field is explicitly suffixed_ms. Original acquisition age is not true GPU exposure age.
Worker stage samples include initial and setup jobs. Counts vary with the setup failure time, so rates are compared as workload diagnostics rather than steady-state throughput estimates.

Only the warmup/failure parent completion records are retained for these failed setups; parent queue/worker/transport/publication distributions therefore have at most2distinct observations per attempt.
worker_seconds includes child startup, both-way serialization/IPC, compute and scheduling. transport_seconds=worker_seconds-compute_seconds is an envelope, not measured pipe-only latency.
Metadata-only auditing writes small JSON files in the worker and is diagnostic overhead. Full NPZ/pickle capture is disabled in all8attempts.
Missing route contact/clearance/duration figures are unavailable, never zero. Process exit0 does not override result statusFAIL.
Applied age diagnostics describe the last accepted evidence; final refusal age may exceed the unchanged limit.
